newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki marks time, hesitant ahead of Ericsson Q1.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki marks time, hesitant ahead of Ericsson Q1.

text.p: Shares were mixed with the HEX index flat in lax trade with many investors on hold ahead of Swedish Ericsson's first-quarter report that could provide a cue for trend-setter Nokia, brokers said.
"We're taking it easy today," one broker said, adding that Thursday's forestry rally had exhausted itself.
Nokia gained 2.50 markka to 308.50 in cautious position taking ahead of the Ericsson results, due after 1300 GMT.
Forestries sagged in fair volume, with UPM trading down 1.50 markka at 118.50. Enso was off 0.50 at 43.00 after saying it was in talks to buy German paper-maker Holtzmann.
Brokers said investors were still digesting the news of a possible acquisition and were still unsure of how expensive it would be to Enso.
"Not everyone will think this is good for Enso," one broker said.

Tamrock rose on a big in-house deal at Alfred Berg, but then returned to neutral. Two million shares, or one and a half percent of Tamrock's total shares, changed hands at 15.00 markka each, up 0.50 before it returned to 14.50.
Metra rose 1.00 markka to 143.00 in lively 20 million markka volume. --Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 235
